description: Named by the fz-go4.18.33 removable-code audit (at b5b341bff). jobs/transport.rs::transport_position_sort_key (~:2066) rebinds executable per-arm inside the same 7-arm match that derives the variant-specific secondary keys (rank/first/second/index). Hoist the symbol: let executable = position.executable(); then match only for the (rank, first, second, index) tuple — removes 7 redundant executable binds, strictly fewer tokens, keeps the per-arm secondary-key logic, mirrors the pattern fz-go4.18.33 established at the other three sites. Audit judged it clearly-better/low-risk. Mechanical; suite green 3x; two-lane audit.
title: Delegate symbol extraction in transport_position_sort_key to TransportPosition::executable
